comment: The standard downloads registry (tools/downloadArtifacts.js; WORKORDER-standardDownloads-101526). One row per forge bundle offered for download. family is NOT here: it is read from the graph (StandardDefinition.standardFamily) or, for a bundle the graph does not hold, from the bundle's own forge declaration. version likewise comes from the graph; versionText is used only for a bundle the graph does not hold. A graph standard with no row here is refused by name, never quietly left out. licenceNoticeList (ML3.1c, 2026-10-26): a bundle whose licence requires notices on every copy; each facet zip carries NOTICE.txt (requiredNoticeTextList verbatim, permissionRecordText) and the agreement at agreementRelativePath under the snapshot, verified against agreementSha256. State [] for none.

offeredBundleList.descriptionText: Common Education Data Standards ontology (RDF/XML), with the Ontology Guide and text-repair layers
Ed-Fi Data Standard (MetaEd model and descriptor code values)
SIF Implementation Specification spreadsheet (159 objects, flattened)
PESC_LD v0.0.2: the JSON-LD College Transcript application profile (TAP CSVs, with the publisher's SHACL as a second oracle)
CTDL: Credential Engine's credential vocabulary (JSON-LD: classes, properties, concept schemes and concepts)
CTDL-ASN: the CTDL Achievement Standards Network profile, for competency frameworks (JSON-LD)
CTDL-QData: the CTDL Quantitative Data vocabulary, for outcome and statistical data (JSON-LD)

JEDx (Jobs and Employment Data Exchange): the JEDx Open API Specification 1.0.0 (HR Open Standards Consortium), its four OpenAPI bundles' components.schemas as one data model (schemas, properties, code lists)
Open Badges 3.0 (1EdTech): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations)

LIF 2.0 (the LIF Initiative's Learner Information Framework): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: entities, inline objects, properties, enumerations), Apache License 2.0 (its LICENSE is in the source download)
CASE 1.1 (1EdTech Competencies and Academic Standards Exchange): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model from the publisher's YAML (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations)

SEDM (the Special Education Data Model), from the working group's working documents (no published version): the element map sheet's SEDM-flagged elements with their option sets, and the IDEA compliance structures
EduAPI 1.0 (1EdTech Edu-API): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations)

MedBiquitous (AAMC health professions education standards): its XML Schema portfolio as one standard of fifteen schema sets (complex types, fields, enumerations, references), from the publisher repository github.com/medbiq/medbiq at 8f5c74a5. Under the MedBiquitous Standards Public License and Terms of Use (https://www.medbiq.org/license): the schemas' own copyright notices are kept; the graph is a derivative made by educoreForge, not an official MedBiquitous specification (the notices are in LICENSE in the source download)
CLR 2.0 (1EdTech Comprehensive Learner Record): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations; 28 of its schemas are CLR's own copies of Open Badges 3.0's)

OneRoster 1.2 Rostering (1EdTech K-12 rostering service): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations) of people, organisations, academic sessions, courses, classes, enrollments and demographics
OneRoster 1.2 Gradebook (1EdTech K-12 gradebook service): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations) of line items, categories, score scales and results

OneRoster 1.2 Resources (1EdTech K-12 resources service): the OpenAPI 3.0 data model (components.schemas: schemas, properties, enumerations) of the learning resources assigned to classes, courses and users
PESC College Transcript message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC College Transcript message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC High School Transcript message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Test Score Report message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Learning Record message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Document Request message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Document Response message schema with the library schemas it imports
PESC Academic ePortfolio message schema with the library schemas it imports
Every PESC schema published on the PESC standards pages, as one aggregate snapshot (64 XSD files)

The EDUcore Enhanced Cockburn use cases, release 1.0 (format v0.11): seven vetted cases with their shared stories, actors, conditions, events, value drivers and subjects, and every citation of another standard as its author wrote it. TQ's own standard (EDUcore), no licence hold.
